entities.name: Jānis Bebris
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jānis Anatolijs Bebris was a Latvian footballer and ice hockey player. He was the main goalkeeper of Latvia national football team in the closing years of the 1930s, and represented Latvia at the 1936 Winter Olympics. After World War II, Bebris played in West Germany and France.
